Name: Zelda Fairy Companions
Author: scuftdustbug
Description:
My first mod! This replaces the fairy companion with several varieties of fairies from The Legend of Zelda series, including named fairies like Navi, Tatl, Tael, and more! 

[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTcgMXmK/navianim2.gif[/img][/center]

Here are the fairy color variations available:
﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vBZ0zSN2/allcolors5.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

[b]
My inspiration, in order from left to right:
[/b]
• Navi (blue body, blue wings)
• Pink body, pink wings
• White body, white wings
• Green body, green wings
• Tael
• Tatl
• Neri
• Leaf
• Tael variant
• Ciela (or a Tatl variant I suppose)
• Blue body with pink wings
• Pink body with blue wings
• Blue
• Purple
• Pink
• Green


This mod also changes the trinket icon to a Fairy Bottle:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/kgPwZ5Hb/bottle.png[/img]

This mod works with Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI, and Content Patcher. Extract the mod into your mod folder and you're all set!

Default color is set as Navi (blue body and blue wings), shown above. I recommend changing the color of your fairy with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]General Mod Config Menu Options[/url].
